name: Dollex Agrotech Limited
summary: Dollex Agrotech Ltd. makes and trades sugar and its by-products in India. Its integrated sugar mill in Datia, Madhya Pradesh, rated at 2,500 TCD, produces plantation white sugar, jaggery and Khandsari sugar, and by-products fuel 3 MW of captive power. A 200 KLPD ethanol distillery is under construction, and much of its revenue comes from Madhya Pradesh.
